_comment: GH#279 canonical: dev debug overlay. Pins (1) HIDDEN BY DEFAULT (D4: captures are full-window, so an overlay-on FEEL shot is contaminated evidence -- the absent-assert at boot is the contract), (2) toggle_overlay renders with a payload drawn from the same snapshot assert_state reads (map cross-checked), (3) toggle off emits hidden. Debug builds only -- the editor binary QA runs under is always a debug build; release exports never construct the overlay (OS.is_debug_build gate).
